source.officialScope: City's official service page describes the public cadastral map as showing basic information for legal lots, official streets/squares and approved subdivision plans in Curitiba's 75 neighborhoods. This is a municipal technical cadastral base, not a national registry or proof of surveyed title boundaries.

nativeIdentity.semanticAssessment: Best native parcel key. The citywide current service aggregate showed every nonnull value unique, though its database index is not marked unique. Preserve as text (including any leading zero).

otherIdFields.objectid: Esri OID; use only as provider row/paging identity, not semantic parcel ID.
otherIdFields.gtm_cod_lote: Integer lot code; nonunique index; 1,916 null rows citywide and unsuitable alone as a global key.
otherIdFields.gtm_cod_quadra: Quadra/block code; intentionally repeats across lots.

reuse.finding: No source-specific open reuse license was found. The MapServer itemInfo has empty licenseInfo/accessInformation; layer copyrightText is empty. IPPUC's official geodownload page labels its information merely informative and disclaims damages, but gives no geometry-reuse grant. Curitiba's general open-data rules allow free use of datasets published on that portal, but the cadastral MapServer layer is not listed there (exact searches for its lot/planta/Indicação Fiscal terms yielded no catalog entry). Do not infer that the portal's general rule applies to this standalone service.
reuse.integrationGate: Written permission or an explicit license applying to this exact MapServer layer is needed before persistence/reuse.

boundedChecks.metadataSemantics: gtm_mtr_area_terreno is the matricula-recorded terrain area; it is not the measured polygon area. Geometry field is esriGeometryPolygon; outSR=4326 is honored. No separate current-as-of/edit timestamp is exposed in layer metadata.

forcedPagingLargeBox.failure: Adapter failed closed on repeated object ID: resultOffset 26 returned one feature (objectid 3436), then resultOffset 27 returned objectids 3436 and 3437.
forcedPagingLargeBox.pageSize20Retry: Also failed: offset 20 returned 19 features ending in 3454; next offset 39 repeated 3454 together with 3455.
forcedPagingLargeBox.implication: Despite supportsPagination=true, repeated/short offset pages make completeness unsafe when a bounded query needs multiple pages; adapter's duplicate-object guard correctly refused a complete result.

recommendation: Keep disabled until reuse rights are resolved and complete paging is demonstrated. Preserve fiscal strings, detect repeated provider row IDs, and never treat failed reads as absent ground.
description: Current source identity, exact lookup and repeated-page failures; runtime remains disabled.
